scope: Singleton V2E2-0026 / C007 / R008 on HD106515A, with all seven existing original-cohort epochs and one fixed discovery reference. C007 core was already visible in completed C006 positive reference flank. This is overlapping post-detection context, not blind or independent validation, new observing time or archive-wide completeness.

frames.barycentric: Query barycentric wavelength cb+x. Native topocentric-air wavelength first multiplied by(1+BERVepoch/c) once.
frames.topocentric: One fixed ct = cb/(1+BERVdiscovery/c); query barycentric wavelength (ct+x)*(1+BERVepoch/c). Equivalently native topocentric wavelength = ct+x. The unique reference and native order use that anchor, with no recentering. Later features can leave the fixed core, which then samples neighboring structure.
frames.native_polynomial: Ascending coefficient polynomial at zero-based native pixel0..4095, inherited topocentric air convention; no wavelength unit/air-vacuum conversion.

grid.core: abs(x)<=0.25: 51 sampled centers [-0.25,+0.25], preserving the original singleton core at 4312.450–4312.950 Angstrom.
grid.interpolation: Linear without extrapolation; mask brackets >1.51×median full-source barycentric wavelength step. Save selected sourcepoints plusonebracket eachside and exact full-source spacing.

normalization.rule: Per profile and frame, pooled signed median of native samples with 1.5<=abs(frame offset)<=3, requiring at least 20 finite samples separately in each flank and a positive pooled median. No fitted background, continuum or line model.
normalization.missing: Zero native left/right coverage is MISSING_LEFT/RIGHT_FLANK_COVERAGE; insufficient finite counts are separate. Invalid or nonpositive references keep raw-only arrays and block normalized RMS. No moved flanks, sign flip, shrink or extrapolation.
normalization.context: Separate left/right native and finite counts, medians and nonpositive fractions; available median distinct from valid reference; signed-window nonpositive fraction and positive finite ERR coverage. Native BUNIT unspecified; merged ADU verified.
normalization.noise: First-difference 1.4826 MAD / sqrt(2) of finite adjacent source samples with both endpoints in the same fixed flank and spacing <=1.51 times median step. Never bridge flanks or gaps. Descriptive low-reference flag median<=3*proxy only if reference valid; no formal SNR.
normalization.structured_neighbor: Completed C006 centers 4310.305–4310.605 Angstrom lie at offsets -2.395 through -2.095 Angstrom inside C007 negative reference flank. Their original cores are retained without masks. These reference medians are not line-free continua. C007 core was already visible in C006 positive flank; shared window values and exposures are not independent validation.

comparisons.merged: 7 epochs × 1 fixed discovery reference × 2 frames × 2 regions = 28 records, including 4 identical-product self-comparisons.
comparisons.native: 1 discovery/order 19 pair × 2 frames × 2 regions = 4 same-exposure native-to-merged records. Shared extraction is not independent confirmation or a physical flux ratio.
comparisons.statistics: Unshifted raw Pearson requires at least ceil(.8*Nregion) common finite raw samples and nonzero exact range. Normalized RMS requires that support in common finite normalized samples. Raw-only profiles block normalized RMS but retain adequately covered raw Pearson. Counts and reasons remain explicit.
comparisons.self_and_dependency_flags: same_exposure and identical_product_self_pair flags are explicit. One discovery product and one catalog record; all seven exposures and overlapping wavelength samples are shared with earlier contexts.

bounded_arrays: Save eight pre-interpolation source windows with exact source indices, original-frame and barycentric wavelengths, signed flux, ERR (NaN for unavailable native errors), source hashes, BERV and full-coordinate spacing. Read only the union required by both fixed-frame windows plus bracketing samples. Full merged coordinates locate slices; native coordinates derive from headers. Already seen overlap with C006 remains explicit.
headers: Verify all seven merged and one native headers before new flux access: exact hashes and identity, recorded metadata, numeric BERV, merged BARYCENT air Angstrom/ADU and unique WAVE/FLUX/ERR single-exposure one-row tables, native 72×4096 shape and unchanged degree/order 19 coefficients. Failed slots remain explicit. Header coordinate coverage does not establish flux or mapping quality.
preserved_raw_context: Copy the exact V2E2-0026 stored raw/native NPZ. Display original raw_cutout/raw_excess after release using separate full panel scales. Preserve all historical primary, secondary, adopted and mapping-stage qualifications. No new raw mapping, background fit or independent pixel claim.

release_contract.policy: Exact public method freeze and input hashes before new observed values; no network; one-shot output refuses overwrite; all source and release hashes rechecked after execution.

plot_rules: Four figures: seven-epoch merged broad/core context with signed and normalized flux in both frames; one native order 19 context; one historical raw/excess pair. Preserve the singleton event/discovery coordinate and R008 label. All finite values retained, no smoothing or clipping; merged frame limits and native raw frame limits match, with 5 percent margins. Historical raw image scales use separate full extrema.
limitations: Post-detection context of one U record and seven reused original-cohort exposures; no new observing time, independent detection or archive-wide completeness. The U label is unchanged.
